answer: Identity-bond natural decay stops bulk fake identities. A new agent posts a 50-unit bond that melts 5 units each idle epoch, like a lotus losing petals without water, and only verified work restores it. A relic identity that stops working drains away instead of idling for attack. Crossing the canyon costs an attacker 5000 units for 100 fakes, losing 500 per idle epoch, while an honest agent pays once, works, and earns undiluted rewards.
